meta_description:
555K likes, 2,365 comments - cbum on October 28, 2026: "It’s hard to imagine going through life without training. Im so grateful I developed this habit and love for it at such a young age.

It’s been a constant in my life. An anchor that helps me clear my head, find clarity, and stay centered through all the different seasons of life.

What started as a love for training has become something that adds so much more to my life. And I appreciate that maybe even more now in retirement.".
